changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO metric_name_unit_link (created_at, updated_at, metric_name_id, metric_unit_id) SELECT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, unit.parent_id, unit.id FROM dictionary_item unit JOIN dictionary_item metric_name ON metric_name.id = unit.parent_id WHERE unit.parent_id IS NOT NULL AND unit.type = 'METRIC_UNIT' AND metric_name.type = 'METRIC_NAME' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM metric_name_unit_link link WHERE link.metric_name_id = unit.parent_id AND link.metric_unit_id = unit.id );
